Rationale.CS1_Results_vs_Conclusion: All evaluable conclusions in the documentation match the results from the implementation. Self-evaluation F1=74.68% (exact match), Proxy-based F1=75.36% (exact match), correlation directions for ECS (negative) and PKS (positive) verified, later-layer PKS effect verified (4.5x stronger than early layers).
Rationale.CS2_Plan_vs_Implementation: A plan file exists (plan.md), and all steps from the final plan are reflected in the implementation: (1) ECS computation via attention and cosine similarity in compute_scores.py, (2) PKS computation via JS divergence in compute_scores.py, (3) TransformerLens with Qwen3-0.6b across 28 layers and 16 heads, (4) Four classifiers trained in classifier.py, (5) Both self and proxy evaluation settings implemented with test data for Qwen and GPT-4.1-mini.
Rationale.CS3_Effect_Size: The reported effects have clearly non-trivial magnitudes: (1) ECS Cohen's d=0.61 (medium effect) between truthful and hallucinated spans, (2) PKS Cohen's d=0.57 (medium effect), (3) Later layers show 4.5x stronger PKS correlation with hallucination than early layers, (4) Method achieves 7-17% F1 improvement over baselines like TruLens and llama-3.1-8b-instant.
Rationale.CS4_Justification: All key design choices and intermediate conclusions are explicitly justified with clear rationale and evidence: (1) ECS as feature justified by negative correlation with hallucination (r=-0.29, p<1e-150), (2) PKS as feature justified by positive correlation and later-layer effect, (3) SVC selection justified by highest validation F1 vs XGBoost overfitting, (4) Proxy model approach justified by successful generalization to GPT-4.1-mini (F1=75.36%).
Rationale.CS5_Statistical_Significance: Key experimental results do NOT report appropriate measures of uncertainty or significance. The plan and documentation report point estimates (F1=74.68%, F1=75.36%, correlation coefficients) without confidence intervals, error bars, or p-values. While the underlying data shows strong statistical significance when computed (all p-values < 1e-100), these measures are not explicitly stated in the documentation.
